sources.title: Telstra International cutting jobs amid AI push
sources.description: Automation to increase under new proposal with Accenture.

sources.title: Telstra and Accenture AI Joint Venture Leads to Over 200 Job Losses
sources.description: Telstra, in partnership with Accenture, is cutting over 200 jobs as part of a $700 million joint venture to implement AI capabilities and increase efficiency. The job losses are directly linked to AI-driven automation, with some roles being outsourced to India. Affected employees face economic harm from these changes.

sources.title: Telstra clarifies 550 job cuts ‘not a result of our adoption of AI’
sources.description: Australia’s leading telecommunications company, Telstra, has confirmed the extent of its job cuts, with a proposed 550 staff across the organisation set to face redundancy.

sources.title: Telstra cuts 2,800 jobs as AI takes over
sources.description: Telstra Purple to bear the brunt of Enterprise overhaul.
